name: CrossDockFlowPlanner
tagline: Every pallet from inbound door to outbound trailer on time – dock map, staging-lane rules and cut-off control in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete cross-dock control tower for DCs, 3PL cross-docks, LTL / parcel hubs and transload sites. Each inbound pallet flow is matched to its outbound load and followed through check-in, unloading, a staging lane and loading to departure – with a drag-and-drop dock map, lane rules for temperature class, hazmat segregation and capacity, a lane suggestion, outbound cut-off countdown with at-risk / missed / cannot-make-it alerts, dwell time, door clash and split-load checks, exceptions, re-planning and depart per load with seal number – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Drag-and-drop dock map: inbound doors, yard, staging lanes, outbound doors
13 rules with fail / warn and next step, Act now list
Lane rules: temperature class, hazmat segregation, capacity warn / block, lane suggestion
Cut-off countdown, at risk, missed and cannot-make-it (transfer time)
Dwell time, late inbound, door clash and split-load checks
Check in per inbound load; depart per outbound load with seal; supervisor depart short
Exceptions with reason and resolve; re-plan to another load
Outbound cut-off timeline with readiness bars
Grid with search, sort, grouping, bulk actions, CSV export, paging
Create / edit with validation, undo, back / forward
Power Fx outputs and six events; FlowsCsv, ActionListJson, SummaryJson
controlType: standard (2 controls: niray_Niray.CrossDockFlowPlanner data-set + niray_Niray.CrossDockFlowPlannerPortal Power Pages)
